body:
# Welcome to Cubed Community!

A renown creative server, with a community you can rely on.

From modern cities to traditional metropolises, medieval towns to fantasy kingdoms, our community create the best projects that builders can achieve. We have a relaxed, versatile environment with rich opportunity for members old and new, so join today and see what magic you can create.

**Cubed hosts multiple projects, including Andea City and Monstera by Alpine1. Follow in Alpine's steps and create cities of your own.**

-  All the tools you need. Unrestricted WorldEdit, Voxel, goBrush.
-  Free plots, with easy to achieve ranks that grant you access to city projects.
-  A versatile custom resourcepack that helps you create amazing buildings.
-  A welcoming community, where you feel at home.
-  Amazing opportunities to grow, start projects and become an amazing builder.

**Want to read more? Check out the wonderful articles by Minecraft.net**

🏙️ Andea City: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/a-lifelike-city

🌇 WestPoint: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/creativity-cubed

🏞 Catalne: https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/past-master

**_Join Cubed today, we're waiting for you! 🧭_**
